grc:name:Παρμενίδης.gloss: a male given name, Parmenides, notably borne by the pre-Socratic philosopher Parmenides of Elea

grc:name:Πάρμυς.gloss: a female given name, Parmys, from Old Persian, a Persian princess and granddaughter of Cyrus the Great
